title: Gallery
summary: The SDK gallery inside your page: every control, element, layout and template with live samples, narrowed by attributes to just what you want to show. Loads on demand in its own frame.

props.name: kind
props.description: What to show: foundations, controls, elements, layouts or templates. Empty shows the controls when a group or control is named, otherwise everything.

props.name: group
props.description: One control group by name ("Forms & inputs") or slug (forms-inputs); with kind layouts or templates, that samples group.

props.name: control
props.description: One control, element or sample id, or a comma separated list ("button,input"); elements also match by tag (pk-tabs).

props.name: theme
props.description: The theme of the gallery and its samples. auto keeps the gallery's own default (dark).

props.name: width
props.description: Render the samples at desktop width or in a 375px phone frame.

props.name: filter
props.description: Search text: only controls whose name (or group) contains it are shown.

props.name: chrome
props.description: none shows only the content, sized to fit it; full keeps the contents nav, the viewport and text size toolbar and the element inspector (Details: an element's API and live markup).

props.name: height
props.description: A fixed height in pixels. 0 fits the content when chrome is none and uses the default height when chrome is full.

props.name: src
props.description: Address of the gallery's embed.html when it is not next to the element module, for example on a CDN prefix. A relative address resolves against the document's base URI (document.baseURI), so it works on a routed page.

props.name: sections
props.description: Sections to add to the gallery's Details drawer (chrome full), as JSON text: a list of { tag?, title, open?, lines?, columns?, rows?, code? }, all text. The element sends them to its frame by message once the gallery is ready and whenever the text changes; tag limits one to an element (pk-button), none shows it for every element. Text only, cut to limits; see js/gallery-sections.js.

parts.name: frame
parts.description: The iframe that hosts the gallery.

cssProperties.name: --pk-gallery-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the frame. The element sets it from height or from the height the gallery reports.

a11y: The frame is titled "SDK gallery". With chrome full, the gallery is a landmark layout with a contents nav, a toolbar and a labelled inspector; with chrome none it is the content alone, and each sample sits in its own titled frame.
